messages:
maria_sales: Acme POC ask: minimal network changes, prefer PrivateLink, no internet egress. Can we list the bare minimum for them to stand up a POC? cc @sam_se @emma_neteng

sam_se: Minimal checklist: region+AZs, VPC id, 1 private subnet per AZ (ENI IPs), account ID to whitelist, SG for endpoint. Decide S3 gateway vs offline bundle.

emma_neteng: PrivateLink pattern: we provide an endpoint-service name (NLB). Customer creates interface endpoint -> traffic stays on AWS backbone, no NAT required for API. ENI per subnet/AZ. If no NAT, add S3 gateway endpoint for model pulls.

akash_acme: We have us-east-1, vpc-0a1b2c3, private subnets in 3 AZs. No NAT allowed. S3 gateway OK. How do we set SGs?

sam_se: SG guidance: endpoint SG permit ingress TCP/443 from your app subnets (or app SG). Egress allow TLS to 0.0.0.0/0 or restrict to our NLB IPs (we'll share ranges). Example create command: ```bash
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0a1b2c3 --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --service-name com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0abcd1234 --subnet-ids subnet-111 subnet-222 subnet-333 --security-group-ids sg-0aa11bb22
```
(Replace service-name with the one we give.)

emma_neteng: S3 gateway snippet (CF): ```yaml
Resources:
  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3
      VpcId: vpc-0a1b2c3
      RouteTableIds: [ rtb-aaa, rtb-bbb ]
```

akash_acme: IPs are tight. How many ENIs?

emma_neteng: One ENI per subnet/AZ used. Recommend reserving ~4 IPs/AZ buffer. If you want Redwood-managed endpoint (we host the runtime) this is minimal. Running Dedicated inside your account increases IP needs (nodes + LB) - suggest /24 per AZ if you opt for that.
